svg.metadata: {"id": "s030", "name": "汉字演变长廊", "cat": "语文与历史", "tags": ["语文", "汉字", "历史", "书法"], "desc": "古色长廊：红柱彩梁间依次陈列甲骨、青铜铭文、竹简、宣纸与活字，中央展板展示象形字到楷书的演变。", "stand": {"ground_y": 910, "x": [600, 1320]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "floor", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "panels_side", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.4, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "panels_right", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.55, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "panel_center", "enter": "zoom", "delay": 0.7, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "corridor", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "lanterns", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "glow", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "plants", "enter": "grow", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#F7EFE0", "wall2": "#EADBC1", "pillar": "#C24A3E", "pillar2": "#9E3A31", "beam": "#2F7A78", "beam2": "#5BA6A0", "beam3": "#E8B95A", "floor1": "#D9CBB0", "floor2": "#BFAE8E", "bone": "#EDE1C6", "bone2": "#CDB98F", "bronze": "#5E9483", "bronze2": "#3F7466", "bamboo": "#D8B66E", "bamboo2": "#B8924E", "paper": "#FFFBF0", "ink": "#2F2C2A", "red": "#C8473A", "type": "#C9A26C", "type2": "#A7804C", "lan": "#E0533F", "gold": "#F2C766", "sky": "#CDE9E6", "leaf": "#77B58C"}}
